title: Diagnostic Report: Elektra (Grupo Elektra)
summary: Elektra.mx, one of Mexico's largest e-commerce retailers on VTEX IO, has a massive catalog (400+ product sitemaps) but suffers from severe mobile performance issues (LCP 21.6s homepage, 30/100 Lighthouse), template-based meta descriptions across products, no customer reviews on PDPs, no cross-sell recommendations, and no editorial content engine. With approximately 3.3M monthly visits and 63% search dependency, these gaps represent significant conversion and organic traffic opportunities.
